Transparent Pricing

Pricing

GreenTree does not publish a rate card, and we would rather explain why than print a number we cannot stand behind. No two commercial properties price the same way — turf area, plant material, access, irrigation zones and service frequency all move the figure, and a contractor who quotes before walking the site is either guessing or leaving room to rebuild the price in change orders later. We walk the property first, then give you a written scope and one number against it.

What a maintenance proposal is priced on

These are the factors that actually move the number on a commercial landscape maintenance contract in South Florida.

FactorWhy it changes the price
Turf area and accessOpen lawn mows fast; narrow islands, slopes, bollards and parked-car obstacles do not. Access dictates equipment, and equipment dictates crew hours.
Service frequencyGrowing season in South Florida is long. Weekly, fortnightly and seasonal-adjusted schedules produce materially different annual figures.
Plant material and bed areaHedges, ornamentals and seasonal colour need pruning cycles and hand weeding. Beds are usually the difference between two properties with identical lawn area.
Irrigation zonesThe number of zones sets how long a scheduled inspection takes. Repairs are quoted separately, so the inspection cost stays predictable.
Pest and disease pressureIntegrated Pest Management is diagnosis-led. A property with chronic chinch bug or fungal pressure needs a different programme than one without.
Debris volume and disposalPalm fronds, storm litter and heavy seasonal drop all carry haul-away cost that varies by property and time of year.

Planting, seasonal colour changes and irrigation repairs are quoted as separate line items rather than folded into the maintenance figure, so you can see what you are approving.

GreenTree serves commercial clients only. If you are looking for residential lawn care, we are not the right fit and will say so on the first call.

FAQs

Frequently asked

Do you work with residential properties?

No. GreenTree is committed solely to commercial clientele — office and industrial parks, condominium and HOA common areas, institutional campuses and retail properties. Our crews, equipment and scheduling are built around commercial sites.

What areas do you serve?

Miami-Dade County, Broward County and Palm Beach County. If your property sits near the edge of that footprint, call us and we will tell you honestly whether we can service it properly.

What is included in a maintenance contract?

It depends on the property, which is why we walk the site before quoting. A typical contract covers scheduled mowing, edging and weeding, hedge and shrub pruning on a cycle, Integrated Pest Management, and irrigation system inspections. Planting and seasonal colour are usually quoted alongside it.

Do you subcontract the work?

No. GreenTree is dedicated solely to landscape maintenance and performs the work with its own crews. The company you contract with is the company that shows up.

How long has GreenTree been in business?

Since 1984 — 42 years serving commercial properties in South Florida, as an independent, family owned and run company.

Are you a Minority Certified vendor?

Yes. GreenTree is a Minority Certified business, which matters if your organisation carries supplier-diversity requirements in its procurement process.

How often will crews be on our property?

On a fixed schedule agreed before the contract starts, so your team knows exactly when the site is serviced. Frequency depends on the property, the plant material and the growing season.

What happens if something needs attention between visits?

Call or email us. We would also rather tell you first — irrigation faults, pest pressure and failing plant material get reported when our crews find them, not after your board notices.
